# StageSpot

> > StageSpot is a theatrical and stage lighting supplies storefront offering professional lighting equipment, accessories, and special effects for entertainment venues and productions.

StageSpot specializes in stage lighting solutions from manufacturers like Mega-Lite and TECLIGHT, featuring moving lights (FOLLOWBOT series), LED fixtures (SIX+ PAR, SIXPAR 200), trusses, gobos, gel filters, and special effects equipment including snow machines and lighting accessories.
